text.p: TresCom International Inc said Wednesday it has retained the Robinson Humphrey Co Inc to help it explore strategic alternatives for increasing shareholder value.
These include alternative sources of financing, identification of strategic partners and sale, or merger of part or all of the company, TresCom said.

The company said results in the wholesale segment, which constitute the majority of revenue, have been disappointing, and credit risks involved in acquiring new customers and growing the segment have continued to increase.

"In light of these changes, together with the acceleration of deregulation spurred by the World Trade Organization agreement, the board of directors has reached the conclusion that exploration of strategic alternatives is in the best interest of the company and its shareholders," the company said in a release.
